cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: The Same Ending
cards.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. First you cancel lunch, then stop calling, then ask for the key.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've only cancelled lunch. I'm exhausted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. That's what he said before seeing me became another job.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow, then? I'll book our usual table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He chose a restaurant too. Public enough that I couldn't beg. Book the corner, please.

confusable: D120 makes ending inevitable; D92 would make contact hopeful.
comparison: Illness care versus lunch cancellation and public venue.
seedUse: Keep B helpful booking reinterpreted as controlled breakup setting.
